content.short: NFT DAO on Cardano focused on the community.
content.description:
Boss DAO is an open membership NFT DAO on the Cardano Blockchain. We aim to bring the benefits of some of the greatest NFT projects on Cardano via a single NFT.

We are one of the first successful NFT DAOs on Cardano with notable pioneers in the industry both within and outside of Cardano. With inspiration from others and a new market with a lot of potential; Boss DAO was formed. Our initial mint sold 4092 NFTs at 150 ADA each. We have since minted 1000 additional NFTs; 160 ADA for holders, and 175 for non-holders. Since our minting, we have completed a multitude of proposals all determined by the community, and auditable on-chain through transaction-based voting.

Boss DAO is a pioneer in the ecosystem of Cardano and aims to contribute to the decentralization of the blockchain via our stake pool and DAO. In addition, we want to provide a launchpad that will assist in launching new projects into our ecosystem. Overall, Boss DAO is early in a very new field and will develop according to best practices while also providing its community with the ability to build along with the core team, rather than waiting on announcements and “hopium”. We are a member-only, permissionless DAO - you don't need anyone's permission to begin working on a new or existing development within the DAO once you're a member. In addition to a voice, Boss DAO gives you power that other projects cannot, the ability to expose yourself to multiple projects/assets via holding just one NFT.
